title: Accounts, discovery and administration
bodyMarkdown:
## Inspect account or operator metadata in the synthetic preview

1. Choose the account or operator plane and the intended context. The presentation-role selector changes visible synthetic controls; it is not authentication or a server grant.
2. Open the required collection (profiles, members/groups, customers, associations or grants). Search/filter it, then inspect details before opening an allowed create/edit dialog.
3. Review tenant, workload, operation, identity/profile and active-window fields. A grant must stay within the acting authority and exact tenant. A presentation hiding Create/Edit is a read-only UI state, not proof of server enforcement.
4. Use synthetic records only. Review/cancel changes first; where a mock confirmation is provided, it changes local demonstration state. Check the resulting record and reload to inspect persistence. Do not infer live membership provisioning or key association from it.

## Billing and profile boundaries

In the preview, inspect current plan/usage before opening a simulated financial action. Review its confirmation/cancel behavior and return to the original plan after a test. No tariff, charge, portal provider or subscription is live. Usage means hosted access events in the product contract, not a key/profile count: local key reuse adds no hosted access. Real invoices/subscriptions require qualified tenant-scoped account services and actual entitlements.

Software custody is not independent HSM custody. A shared runtime/KEK compromise may expose reachable DEKs; a required stronger profile must be reported unavailable rather than silently downgraded. No administrative page displays private key material.

## Prepare real administration

Resolve the selected service, trusted issuer/client, tenant, role and supported interface before changing anything. Local config CRUD edits declarations; it does not create remote administration tools. The documented hosted end state covers authorized association/enrollment/window/metering metadata, not uploaded configuration. Signed administration, approvals, revision controls and required audit follow the canonical administration contract. If an outcome is uncertain, inspect the supported operation state under the same identity before repeating it; do not infer rollback from cancellation.
capabilityStatus: Account, billing, grant, fleet and association screens are synthetic previews: no real charge, enrollment, membership or key operation occurs. Hosted administration needs a supported authorized service; required HSM custody is not supplied by software custody.
